instruction: A full shot cinematic still of a grassy outdoor backyard surrounded by green trees. On the left, the woman in the crochet vest (R2) is blindfolded with a peach bandana, swinging a wooden bat upwards. In the background center, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands watching attentively. On the right, the man in the patterned tee (R3) stands in a defensive, excited stance with his hands raised forward. The blindfolded woman swings the wooden bat upwards at a red heart-shaped pinata hanging from above, while her friends stand behind her, watching and reacting to the swing. The scene is illuminated by bright daylight filtering through the trees.
